verdict.rationale: Consensus publishes a first-party pricing document (/.well-known/pricing.md) that lists plan features such as Deep Searches and centralized billing for organizations, so a pricing reference exists before committing. The excerpts show no actual prices, tier names, or usage caps. Missing for 10: concrete plan prices, documented per-plan usage limits (e.g., Deep Search quotas), free-vs-paid tier comparison, independent corroboration.
